output.answer: Stripe's most recent company-set valuation is $159 billion, from the employee/shareholder tender offer it announced on February 24, 2026 (shares at $62.47) — up about 74% from the $91.5 billion set in its February 2025 tender. As of today, secondary-market data suggests it has climbed further: Forge's Oct 1, 2026 pricing implies roughly $184.4 billion, up ~99.6% year over year. Stripe remains private, with co-founder John Collison saying there are no imminent plans for a public listing.
caveats: The ~$184.4 billion figure is an implied private-market (secondary) valuation from Forge data as of Oct 1, 2026, not a valuation Stripe itself set; the last company-announced valuation is $159 billion (Feb 24, 2026 tender offer).

Stripe is privately held, so its valuation is only refreshed at episodic tender offers and can move between them; secondary-market prices are thin and may not reflect what public-market investors would pay.
Stripe has no imminent plans for an IPO per John Collison (Feb 2026), so no public-market valuation exists as of today.

passages.quote: SAN FRANCISCO AND DUBLIN—Stripe, the programmable financial services company, has signed agreements with investors to provide liquidity to current and former Stripe employees through a tender offer at a $159B (€135B) valuation. While the majority of funds for the tender offer are being provided by investors including Thrive Capital, Coatue, a16z, and others, Stripe will also use a portion of its own capital to repurchase shares.

Forge’s latest [data](https://marketplace.forgeglobal.com/marketplace/companies/stripe) shows a $72.45 Forge Price for Stripe as of Oct. 1, implying a $184.4 billion valuation. The figure is up 99.64% over the past year, according to Forge, and is above the company’s $159 billion post-money valuation from a February 2026 tender offer, when shares changed hands at $62.47.
Feb 24 (Reuters) - Stripe was valued at $159 billion in a tender offer for employees and shareholders, the fintech firm said on Tuesday, a more than 70% jump from a similar share sale a year earlier.

[Stripe Inc.](https://www.bloomberg.com/quote/0170016D:US), which helps businesses accept payments online, has reached a $159 billion valuation in an employee tender offer, co-founder and president John Collison said in an interview.

That valuation is up from the [$106.7 billion](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2025-09-23/stripe-s-valuation-rises-above-its-2021-peak-to-106-7-billion) Stripe secured last year, underscoring its staying power as one of fintech’s most valuable companies even as it keeps investors waiting for any public market debut. There are no imminent plans for a public listing, Collison said.
